variants.prompt: On the deck of a sleek, black yacht, the striking young woman poses with confident poise against the polished railing, the warm glow of sunset casting a golden sheen on her sun-kissed skin. Her vibrant red hair billows in the ocean breeze, while bright hazel eyes sparkle with a touch of mischief. A barely-there bikini leaves little to the imagination, the sheer fabric clinging to her curves and drawing attention to every sculpted detail.
